string_values: Partial western Atlantic cSEC-context31–35W reach near the Fernando de Noronha island/seamount chain,with1.5–6.5S searches. Exclude coastal NBC/NBUC,northern/southern SEC branches,eastward SEUC and detached eddies as target identities. Broad westward maxima do not independently establish central-branch membership,an island-clear current axis or one coherent core. Source approximate100m regional surface extent is context,not an imposed cutoff,whole-current thickness or annual range.
Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.

Partial east-central Pacific SEC(S) surface-branch100–140W reach,with0.5–5.5S searches. Exclude SEC(N),equatorial EUC,deep EIC,subsurface countercurrents/Tsuchiya jets,SECC,western boundary flow and detached eddies as target identities. Deeper same-sign SEC extensions or other currents can connect in the model;geographic maxima do not independently identify branches. The separate142E northern-component150m source reference is not transferred to this southern reach.

Partial Indian SEC90–70E southern zonal-mode reach,with10–15S searches. Northern northwestward meanders can lie outside these fixed windows and are not filled by moving gates. Exclude SECC,SCTR recirculation,coastal Madagascar/Agulhas branches,upstream ITF straits and detached eddies as target identities. Salinity fronts,SSH contours and20C thermocline depth are separate diagnostics,not velocity axes or current bottoms. No reproduction of Carr/Chen model fields,source grid lengths or source seasonal geometry is claimed.

temporal_scope: January15 and July15,2022UTC00Z; individual snapshots, not seasonal means or annual extrema.
method: Separate basin regional components, paired depth contours and unique linear strips on consecutive native latitude columns. All30cases in one cumulative query.
window_interpretation: Original classic complete upper0-200m core selection is inherited globally, not a measured layer or tracing cap. Atlantic approximate100m regional surface context and separate Pacific142E northern-component150m reference do not impose southern-branch model boundaries. Indian20C thermocline/salinity/SSH diagnostics are not velocity bottoms.
surface_gate_interpretation: Strict5cm/s surface selection applies to original selected profiles, not every connected run. Native surface graph connectivity is topology only; defaultfalse on unresolved cases is not measured surface disconnection or current absence.
layer_metric_interpretation: Paired thickness is lower minus upper, not absolute lower depth/core depth/search endpoint/bed/instrument limit. Contiguous native minimum span is conditional component-model support, not a physical bound. Censored/missing remain null, not zero or absent named currents.
range_interpretation: Native bracket scenarios are not confidence intervals, physical uncertainty or annual ranges.
identity_scope: Atlantic partial central-context31-35W near island/seamount chain, Pacific southern-branch100-140W and Indian southern zonal-mode90-70E searches remain separate. No current/family-wide depth, shared physical body or inherited basin/boundary depths. Broad same-sign flow can connect distinct branches or mesoscale signals. Fixed gates omit unsearched branches/meanders.
interpretation: Partial fixed-longitude component geometry is not independently flow-normal/fullwidth/wholebody. No joining sections, terrain clearance or physical water volume.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU; original attribution and qualifiers retained.
